title: Rust: bare .unwrap() in test code needs .expect()
description: 50+ instances of bare .unwrap() in test code (lichen-senml, lichen-ipv6, lichen-client tests). When these panic, the AI sees 'called unwrap() on Err(...)' with a line number but no semantic context about what was being attempted. Fix: replace with .expect("description of what should have succeeded") so test failures are self-documenting. Prioritize shared_vectors test files since those are the cross-impl conformance tests.
